Name: EightCorners
Author: prazon99
Description:
This map replaces the Four corners map with an edited version that adds 4 more sections for those who play with more then 4 players. I suggest playing with no more then 8 players as the name suggests.

There are 2 berry bushes added to the bottom center that you'll need to repopulate using reset terrain features if adding to an existing save.

There are no other unique special features added to the new 4 sections. You will have to use the unlimited player mod to add more cabins to the other sections and of course you'll need to build them yourself as they will not auto populate on creation of a new save.
